title: the test-builder weak-area lane consumes the law-pinned view (slug->rootId bridge + labeled sample fallback + server-side live assembly)
basis: CD-A run-001 (PR #489, open/CI-green at branch time, NOT yet merged to main) closed its tranche with three explicit hub disclosures, operator-gated as 'CD-A-hub follow-up': demo-era client-side SAMPLE thresholds on the builder's weak-area lane; api.ts testBuilderWeaknessOptions with ZERO callers; no slug->rootId resolution exists
this run executes exactly that follow-up on a branch off origin/main f271d3a4 (fetch-first; main had advanced with the parallel R3 stage-B wave-1 lane, no overlap with the hub test-builder files)

the bridge of record: the hub course registry's EXPLICIT curriculumCode (courses.json, V53/ADR-030 law: hub-maintained, never derived) matched against SubjectView.curriculumVersion.code on the wire, yielding knowledgeNodeId = rootId; 60/106 registry rows carry curriculumCode; everything else fail-closes

laws_held: explicit-only resolution: the bridge reads the registry's hub-maintained curriculumCode against the wire's curriculumVersion.code - no slug parsing, no fuzzy name matching, no first-match-wins on ambiguity (fail-closed null)
server order is law: liveWeakLane never re-sorts; the frozen comparator's order (meanMastery asc nulls-last -> active-misconception learners desc -> code) renders verbatim

honesty: null mastery renders 'mastery unmeasured' (never 0%, never a fabricated band); the sample lane is LABELED demo data in every render; live misconception counts are learners, sample counts are tracked inventory - the units never conflate
coverage gaps are never weak: informational rows without checkboxes, excluded from toggleAllWeak and from the flagged-weak count

vocabulary isolation: sample selections (bundle subtopic codes) feed ONLY the demo hub assembler; live selections (knowledge topicNodeIds) feed ONLY the server testBuilderPreview - the source-flip effect clears selection so a mixed Set can never exist

the demo assembler + printable PDF pipeline are byte-untouched on the sample plane (saves, drafts, download modal, manual adds all keep their semantics; drafts keyed by code still restore because sample keys ARE codes)
